```artifact
Feature: Lab Request and Patient Prescription Management
  @tags {U31_10, U31_11, U31_12}

  Background:
    Given the lab system is operational with online and offline capabilities
    And the lab in-charge can view and update open lab requests
    And patients can view their prescriptions and print invoices
    And admins can print and email prescriptions and invoices
    And quarterly archiving of patient profiles and old consultation requests is implemented

  Scenario: Lab In-charge updates open lab requests while samples and tests are offline
    @requirement U31_10
    When the lab in-charge updates the status of an open lab request
    Then the system reflects the updated status correctly
    And the samples and tests remain offline

  Scenario: Patient views and prints prescription and invoice
    @requirement U31 extr
    Given a patient with a prescription and invoice
    When the patient accesses their prescription and prints the invoice
    Then the prescription is displayed and the invoice is correctly printed

  Scenario: Admin prints and emails prescription and invoice
    @requirement U31 extr
    Given an admin with access to a patient's prescription and invoice
    When the admin prints and emails the prescription and invoice
    Then the prescription is correctly printed and the invoice is correctly emailed

  Scenario: Quarterly archiving of inactive patient profiles and old consultation requests
    @requirement U31 extr
    Given patient profiles with no consultation requests for the past 3 years and old consultation requests older than 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then all relevant profiles and requests are archived

Scenario Outline: Quarterly archiving of patient profiles with no consultation requests for the past 3 years
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given patient profiles with no consultation requests for the past 3 years
    And old consultation requests older than 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then only the profiles with no recent requests should remain active
    And old consultation requests should be archived
    Examples:
    | No recent requests | Old requests | Expected outcome |
    | Yes             | Yes         | Profiles remain active |
    | Yes             | No          | Profiles remain active |
    | No              | Yes         | Profiles are archived |

Scenario Outline: Quarterly archiving of old consultation requests
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given old consultation requests older than 3 years
    And no recent consultation requests for each patient
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then all old requests are archived
    Examples:
    | Yes             | Yes         | All requests archived |
    | Yes             | No          | No requests archived |
    | No              | Yes         | All requests archived |

Scenario: Error handling for updating lab requests
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given the lab in-charge attempts to update an open lab request
  When the lab in-charge encounters an error
  Then appropriate error handling should occur
  Examples:
  | Yes             | Expected error handling |
  | No              | Error handling for invalid input |

Scenario: Error handling for patient accessing prescription and invoice
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given a patient attempts to access their prescription and invoice
  When the patient encounters an error
  Then appropriate error handling should occur
  Examples:
  | Yes             | Error message for system error |
  | No              | Error message for invalid input |

Scenario: Error handling for admin printing and emailing prescription and invoice
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given an admin with access to a patient's prescription and invoice
  When the admin encounters an error
  Then appropriate error handling should occur
  Examples:
  | Yes             | Error message for system error |
  | No              | Error message for invalid input |

Scenario: Error handling for quarterly archiving process
  @requirement U31 extr
  Given the archiving process is triggered
  When the system encounters an error
  Then appropriate error handling should occur
  Examples:
  | Yes             | Error message for system error |
  | No              | Error message for invalid input |
```

The "extr" tag is used to indicate requirements related to the patient's prescription and invoice functionality. The expected outcomes are simplified and should be further refined based on the specific system's expected behavior. The error handling scenarios assume a generic error message for system errors, which should be replaced with concrete expected messages based on the system's error handling behavior. The examples in the Scenario Outline tables are designed to cover normal, edge, and invalid scenarios, but they may need to be adjusted based on the actual system's capabilities and constraints.
